claims.text: Loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS.
The shortcoming must be reported on DA Form 2404 Equipment Inspection and Maintenance Worksheet or DA Form 5988-E (automated) immediately after the PMCS.
The shortcoming must be reported before corrective action is taken.
The shortcoming will be recorded in the equipment record.
The specified tightening torque for the starter mounting bolts is 40 lb-ft (54 N•m).
